name: davinci-editor
description: Video editing in DaVinci Resolve Studio 21+ via the DaVinci Resolve MCP server: project bootstrap, Apple Log to Rec.709, ColorChecker chart match, natural skin grade, depth background blur, Ukrainian transcription, text-based rough cut, camera + screen sync with PiP, MotionVFX catalog, sound design, voice isolation, loudness finish for YouTube, edit by colored markers and role-based track layout.

footage_bin.title: Footage bin
footage_bin.description: Media pool bin with the main camera footage, '/'-separated path from the root bin.

templates_dir.title: Grade templates folder
templates_dir.description: Folder with DRX grade templates (base node tree). Skills export new templates here.

work_dir.title: Work folder
work_dir.description: Folder for transcripts, cut lists, exported stills and reports. Relative paths resolve against the Claude Code working directory.

output_gamma.title: Rec.709 output gamma
output_gamma.description: Display gamma of the Rec.709 output transform: 'Gamma 2.4' (YouTube/broadcast default) or 'Gamma 2.2'.

transcription_language.title: Transcription language
transcription_language.description: Language code for DaVinci transcription (project setting transcriptionLanguage).

filler_words.title: Hard filler words
filler_words.description: Comma-separated filler sounds that are always proposed for cutting.

soft_filler_words.title: Soft filler words
soft_filler_words.description: Comma-separated words that are fillers only sometimes; flagged for review, never cut automatically.

pause_threshold_ms.title: Pause threshold (ms)
pause_threshold_ms.description: Silences longer than this are proposed for tightening.

cut_handle_ms.title: Cut handle (ms)
cut_handle_ms.description: Breathing room kept on each side of a cut so words are not clipped.

marker_colors.title: Marker color map
marker_colors.description: Comma-separated Color=task pairs for marker-edit. Tasks: cut, keep, doubt, chart, switch, broll, transition, chapter, title, zoom, sfx, music, audio-problem, shorts, thumbnail, claude.

video_tracks.title: Video tracks (bottom to top)
video_tracks.description: Comma-separated Name:ClipColor for the base video tracks, lowest first.

audio_tracks.title: Audio tracks
audio_tracks.description: Comma-separated Name:ClipColor for the base audio tracks, first = A1.

protected_tracks.title: Tracks never deleted
protected_tracks.description: Comma-separated track roles that cleanup never removes, even when empty.

track_template.title: Timeline template (.drt)
track_template.description: Optional empty timeline exported as .drt with track names and header colors; new timelines are created from it.

timeline_resolution.title: Timeline resolution
timeline_resolution.description: Horizontal resolution WIDTHxHEIGHT for new projects; vertical swaps it.

timeline_fps.title: Timeline frame rate
timeline_fps.description: Frame rate for new projects, as Resolve writes it: '25', '29.97', '30', '50'…

skin_strength.title: Skin correction strength
skin_strength.description: Share of the skin hue offset from the skin tone line that natural-skin-grade corrects, 0-1.

skin_max_saturation.title: Skin saturation cap
skin_max_saturation.description: Chroma/luma ratio above which skin saturation is reduced.

depth_strength.title: Background blur strength
depth_strength.description: 'medium' = the DEPTH node of the base template; 'light' or 'strong' use depth-<strength>.drx on the Color Group post-clip graph.

pip_layout.title: PiP corner
pip_layout.description: Where the camera sits in PiP sections: corner-br, corner-bl, corner-tr, corner-tl.

pip_size.title: PiP size
pip_size.description: PiP camera width as a share of the frame width.

sfx_library_dir.title: SFX library folder
sfx_library_dir.description: Folder with sound effects to index for sound-design.

music_library_dir.title: Music library folder
music_library_dir.description: Folder with licensed music to index for sound-design.

music_bed_lufs.title: Music under speech (LUFS)
music_bed_lufs.description: Integrated loudness of music beds under dialogue.

music_solo_lufs.title: Music without speech (LUFS)
music_solo_lufs.description: Integrated loudness of music in intro, outro and pauses.

sfx_peak_db.title: SFX peak (dBFS)
sfx_peak_db.description: Sample peak level sound effects are normalized to.

loudness_target_lufs.title: Mix loudness target (LUFS)
loudness_target_lufs.description: Integrated loudness of the final mix; YouTube plays back at -14.

true_peak_db.title: Peak ceiling (dBFS)
true_peak_db.description: Highest allowed peak of the final mix.

fairlight_preset.title: Fairlight preset
fairlight_preset.description: Optional Fairlight preset (bus limiter, music ducking) that audio-finish applies; created once by the user.
